about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers car and light truck transport, night and out of hours calls. We work out of Raeford and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Shamira Brooks
reviews.text: Big shoutout to this company for real! I broke down because of my tire and they came through and got my spare on QUICK. Super nice the whole time too, which made a stressful situation way easier to deal with. It’s always a blessing when people treat you with kindness and actually care. I really appreciate them getting me back on the road safely!

reviews.author: Keshia Hayes
reviews.text: The receptionist Sierra is very unprofessional. She couldn’t show me a price list or their policy she stated that they didn’t have one. The company states they’re open 24 hours, but they’re not!!! My car broke down on a Friday around 5pm I went back, and It was towed around 8 PM.(IN THE STATE OF NC 24-48hrs is ABANDONMENT) The lady that I spoke with Friday night said that she would note that I tried to get my car the same day. I was charged over the weekend being that they were closed but say their 24 hours my total was $575 due to a flat tire. I highly do not recommend unless Sierra is outside cutting grass and from behind the desk.

reviews.author: Kate Fentress
reviews.text: Happened on a whim that Geico dispatched Brownie’s to tow me from Fayetteville all the way home to Columbia after being in Raleigh for work training today. Josh by far made this experience so much less stressful than I envisioned a 2.5 hour ride with just me and a driver would ever have been. So professional and courteous considering the distance he had to drive me. Thank you to Brownie’s and Josh for saving me tonight! Will be recommending you to my NC colleagues for sure!

reviews.author: Harrison Frenzel
reviews.text: Levi was very professional and his driver was quick, skilled, and confident in his abilities. They have nice trucks and are very communicative through the process of relocating a vehicle for me. Thank you, Levi and team!

reviews.author: Precious Feely
reviews.text: Caught a flat on the highway on a busy Saturday night. The female dispatcher was so helpful and kind, which lessened my anxiety. Jacob arrived quickly and had my vehicle home in no time. 5 stars from me for sure!

reviews.author: Julisa Sandoval
reviews.text: Horrible service. I had my car towed to my house and I decided to ride with my friend and told them I was going to meet them there. I waited for them for more than hour and the drive there was supposed to take only 11 minutes. I called them and they said that my car was already dropped off. I asked them to send me the pictures that they described and they said they were not allowed to send me any pictures. My friend and I drove for a long time until we found my car and I called them asking them to get my car towed to the right location and they said they were not going to do so, if I needed the service I would need to pay again. The lady over the phone said her name was Sierra but she was not going to provide her full name and she hung up the call.

reviews.author: nunya nunya
reviews.text: Brownies is a life saver!!!! I caught a flat leaving Walmart and the estimated wait time was 1 hour. Dustin from Brownies made it there in less than 20minutes. Not only was he kind and understanding he explained what caused my flat. Dustin is awesome!!!! Brownie now has a customer for life !!!!’

reviews.author: Frank Cookson
reviews.text: If you need anything towed including a toolbox I highly recommend Brownies Towing and their driver Chase. The best hands down.

reviews.author: Jewel Marie
reviews.text: Dallas/Will was a great driver he showed up when he said he would, was completely professional. When the base would not allow him to tow us through the base, we enjoyed the back roads to the shop.

reviews.author: Sandra Nuñez Perez
reviews.text: The customer service was extremely unprofessional and unethical. I am very disappointed with the conduct of both the drivers and the customer service representative. This matter was handled poorly and without accountability. I would not recommend this company. If I could, I would give them zero stars.

reviews.author: ric rosel
reviews.text: Had to get my semi truck towed and scheduled a time to do so. Brownies called to inform of delay for pick up, set up new time and showed up before rescheduled time. Great customer service and they delivered my truck with no issues. Thank you Brownies!!

reviews.author: paris lon
reviews.text: First of all, I love that they are super fast. If your ETA is 60 minutes, they’ll call you in 10 minutes saying they’re 7 minutes around the corner! I have an older car that’s been showing her age in this triple digit heat. Brownie’s Towing has been a lifesaver. I’ve called several times within this last month. They have the most professional crew- down to the lady that answers the phone in the office to their road crew. A special shout out to Mr. Abe that only came out to jump my classic but offered to change a flat tire on my other car (I was going to do it myself). I would have been okay with him ignoring the flat tire because it was SO HOT that morning! I called my insurance company to make sure he got credit for that additional job. Also, a special thanks to another tow driver, I think his name is Glen as well as the young man from West Palm beach that’s very knowledgeable about older cars. Honestly, every single crew member I’ve met have been super professional.

reviews.author: Michael Long
reviews.text: Called at 3:30 for immediate assistance due to our vehicle being broke down beside the highway. Our driver Dovain was to us with in an hour. He was very professional and courteous, while also making sure to take care of our property. Will call this company again if needed.

reviews.author: Justin Naylor
reviews.text: I had a great experience when my motorcycle battery died at a gas station. An older gentleman came and jumped it. It took half the time to arrive that Geico said it would. The guy extremely nice and professional. Would Recommend!

reviews.author: Vicki Rytter
reviews.text: We were coming to VA from Florida returning from a vacation. At the rest stop in 95 we noticed a bad leak from our RV. John came to our rescue to tow . He was friendly and professional. He made a bad day better. Thank you John. The way you handled our bad situation was awesome. Definitely a 5 star company.

reviews.author: Terry
reviews.text: So I've had to use their services multiple times and every experience that I've had has been great. Today I was stranded out in the country and they got to me quick. Less than 2 months ago I also locked my keys in the car and finally gave in and contacted my insurance and the same guy got to me quick and popped my door open in seconds. I definitely would use their services again when needed.

reviews.author: Grier Taylor
reviews.text: Horrible experience dealing with Brownies. They towed my car from my driveway to a shop. The driver Chase drove off my driveway and cracked multiple pieces of my driveway. I immediately called him and explained the situation. He told me "there was no other way to get your car". Yes there was and he never asked. After multiple attempts to reach Brownies they still have yet to answer me. Even after my lawyer reached out to them Brownies has yet to answer me or my lawyer.

reviews.author: Holly Hersey
reviews.text: This was the best roadside assistance I've ever had. I had a flat on I-95. Brownie's was dispatched by my insurance company. By the time I finished moving luggage from the trunk to my backseat, they were there. The tow truck driver was very helpful even to the point of advising me on which areas were good to look at for a last minute hotel as well as which areas were NOT good. Gave me rock solid advice on a tire company to call the next morning. He was very cognizant of safety, and just incredibly nice. Fabulous customer service!

reviews.author: Melissa Martin
reviews.text: Car wouldn’t start this morning. Went through GEICO and said Brownies was 60 mins out. About 20 mins later Will showed up and got to work. Figured out it was the battery and her towed me to get a new one. He went the extra mile to help me with some information about my car at the auto store because I am clueless about that stuff. Couldn’t recommend more. Professional and an absolute life saver!

reviews.author: Dustin Sheets
reviews.text: Great place of business. Did a offroad recovery of my 24 wrangler no extra charge of what I was originally quoted by my insurance. Fast response time & very respectful didn't catch the drivers name but he was driving truck 11. Thank you

reviews.author: Talaya Smith
reviews.text: Had them tow my vehicle from a shop to my home when he got here I asked him to move the vehicle over so it wasn’t close to the middle of the driveway, I live on a hill and it was left in the middle of the hill in an unsafe spot. When I called to ask them to come back because I could still see him down the road he blocked my number and I called the company and the woman on the phone said that he doesn’t get paid to move it and that he gets paid to tow it and it’s not their problem. He also left markings all up and down the driveway including a wide line of oil.

reviews.author: Sandra Wertz
reviews.text: When one of our work vehicles need a tow Bownies is the only company I call. Everyone I have talked to from the office staff to the drivers have always been a pleasure to work with. Levi is my favorite! I thank you guys for helping out when I need you Sandra with Superior Renovations NC

reviews.author: Madalyn
reviews.text: Jim was super helpful. We had to leave our car on the side of the road to make it to an important doctor's appointment. He made sure to call when he got to the car and once he got it home. It definitely put my mind at ease. Their pricing is normal for towing, but I would use them again because of how awesome they were. Jim was our driver and I'm so grateful for his understanding and help!

reviews.author: Christine Argueza
reviews.text: Initial estimate from Geico was 1 hr 15 mins for Brownies to come out. Jim Wallace (?) the driver showed up in 25 mins. Such a pleasant experience from this company and excellent customer serve from Jim. Hopefully we never have to be towed again, but definitely recommend Brownies and Jim in the future.

reviews.author: Chassidy Laws
reviews.text: Received service 8-2025. The gentleman that assisted my family was very polite. The service was efficient and the wait time was not long. My family will definitely request your services again if needed!

reviews.author: Alinea (Alinea)
reviews.text: Highly recommended - they are not opportunistic trying to nickel and dime, like a lot of other* towing/recovery companies; >unfortunately that does happen quite a bit in monopolized areas (what other choice do you have, when they are the only people in the area with set equipment*) Long story short, if you are in a pinch and need some help - I can honestly say they will get the job done/no extra fees & without trying to burn a hole in your pocket! They met up with our driver at Ft. Liberty (Ft. Bragg) this morning to unload a forklift

reviews.author: Falzon
reviews.text: I needed a tow this past Saturday and through my insurance i received Brownies. The tow truck driver John was very helpful, knowledgeable and accommodating. Would recommend him 10 out of 10!!!!!!!! Thanks John for your service and professionalism!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: T Quinones
reviews.text: Received their service through onstar. The estimated ETA was 2 hours- Brownies arrived in 20 minutes! My driver ANTON arrived and had me back in my car in less than 5 minutes- he also taught me a thing or two about my vehicle that I never knew in the 5 years of having it- he wouldn’t even accept my tip! 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: stephanie askin
reviews.text: Brownies was assigned to help me through my insurance company. After the previous tow company did not show. The technician was so kind and accommodating to my situation. My 5 year old had to tag along for the ride and that was no problem at all we got his car seat in and took off. When I ran into issues at the end destination before my car was even unloaded the technician went well above and beyond for me. I will forever be grateful for his kindness and help, he will never know how much that turned such a crappy situation around. I will always recommend Brownies and use them again if needed in the future.

reviews.author: Cherene Comick
reviews.text: So I locked my keys in the car, and brownies was there within a half hour. The technician was kind and efficient and soon I was back in my car! It’s one thing when a business gives you what you need and it’s another thing when they take time to be really pleasant about it as well!

reviews.author: Lindsey Woody
reviews.text: Driver 15 threw something off his truck and busted my windshield. Spoke to someone about the situation, I’m assuming the owner. He stated he was an “honest” person. Said person stated we had to claim on our insurance due to road hazard because nothing came off the truck. I wouldn’t trust this “honest” person with my vehicle.

reviews.author: Melisa Sandoval
reviews.text: Very disappointing service. The driver was unprofessional, and the overall experience was frustrating. I do not recommend this company.

reviews.author: Alleigha Tachelle
reviews.text: I didn’t use them for services but I was stuck on the road and Dalton truck #6 saw me in the road helped me back my car off the road and gave me a business card to call another wrecker. He was very nice and the lady that answered the phone was as well. Will definitely keep their card if I’m in need of a tow.

reviews.author: AverageSavage
reviews.text: These guys are amazing! I had gotten my truck stuck in a very bad, muddy dirt trap, and a gentleman came out to assess the damage, and even see if he could get it unstuck. When he looked at it, he said he doubted it, but he said, “All I can do is try.” Try he did! He got my truck out in a matter of 5 minutes. There was absolutely zero damage done to my truck and the price was incredibly low compared to other towing companies. I was covered by my insurance for $50, so I had to pay $55 out of pocket. A total of $105. Even without insurance, this price was insanely affordable compared to different companies. I was told by another company that it would cost me $250-$300 if they did it. Big thanks to Brownie’s! If I remember the man’s name who helped us out, I’ll update my review.

reviews.author: Dulce Ledezma
reviews.text: Our car popped a tire and we just needed it towed back home. We kept calling them to reach them but took them a while to answer and when they did they said a tow truck would show up in 90 minutes. They called back about half the time and said they would send a different guy because the first guy wasn’t answering their phone. My husband kept calling them to see if they were close but the second guy did not answer. We sat around for about 2+ hours until they called back and said we would get a refund (they charged us about $250) because none of the tow trucks guys were picking up their phones. Would not recommend this place to anyone they had horrible customer service. Does not even deserve the one star.

reviews.author: Alexandria Prince
reviews.text: Dalton was super friendly and helpful getting my car towed! It took less than an hour to get the car towed . Thanks for an amazing experience

reviews.author: Nathan Stoltzfus
reviews.text: Brownies not only towed my car to exactly the right place--Bill and Anton are today's Good Samaritans, going the extra mile to find me stranded along I95. My luck seemed to be bad along with my flat tire until i was connected with these guys, who really cared and made me feel good again about being here in a hustle bustle world. So if you get the chance call on Bill and Anton, who even waited until my tire was changed, and escorted me back to i95 and sent me on my way feeling blessed.

reviews.author: Aaliyah Castro
reviews.text: My friend & I were on a roadtrip from Pennsylvania to Florida, somewhere in North Carolina our tire pops and our roadside assistance sent over Brownies Towing. We’re thankful for their help, they were so kind and quick. They made sure us 2 girls knew where to get a new tire and they were super efficient. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.text: I was locked out of my car and my roadside assistance came from this company. The worker arrived faster than the estimated arrival time and he was friendly and went over and beyond to help get my keys out my car. I definitely recommend this company. I'm not sure what their prices are b/c my insurance company GEICO sent them out to me. It was covered under my roadside assistance.

reviews.author: Steven Smith
reviews.text: Driver...Josh....was very knowledgeable and patient. Very nice young man. I will use your service in the future. Thanks

reviews.author: Angel Medina
reviews.text: If you need fast, friendly and reliable, use brownies. Estimated time was an hour to arrive and rescue my wife, they got there in 20 mins. They properly towed the vehicle and delivered my family to me safe.

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.text: Such a great towing service, my recovery specialist was Art and he was so communicative, patient, and kind! Would absolutely recommend Brownies to anyone. Art made a long and not so great day for me much better and easier.

reviews.author: Karyn Hegler
reviews.text: Called for towing through my insurance company. He arrived in about 30 minutes. Turns out my battery cable jus needed a wiggle and a jump for my car to start. Thanks for the great service.

reviews.author: Shawn T.
reviews.text: I thought this would be an easy process. I was wrong!! I was simply stuck in the mud and needed a winch out. Their prices started at $125. When they got here, They wanted me to sign a damage waiver!! So if they damage my car by simply pulling it out of the mud they are reliable!! If you own a towing business and need that you shouldn't be in business! .. One young kid and some older creepy guy was who showed up!!

reviews.author: Sam Tyner
reviews.text: Mr. Jim was so kind to me and was there super fast. I am a college student and my car broke down and I’m very far from anyone that could help and Mr. Jim made sure I was safe and had everything I needed once he got me and my car to a shop. I appreciated him talking to me which helped with my anxiety. I will certainly recommend them to my fellow ladies as I felt so safe the whole time. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Chad Christian
reviews.text: Brownies was very fast and courteous. They delivered our vehicle back home safely and parked it perfectly. The vehicle ran very poorly but lucky for us it was only a bad coilpack ! Thank you for getting us out of a jam.

reviews.author: Leigh M
reviews.text: Mr. Art was the best representative from this company! He was extremely nice and informative about the process. He made sure I was safe, kept me informed on his eta and was so professional. There were no scratches or marks from his tools and he made me feel safe around the area. Thank you, Art!

reviews.author: Marie Smith
reviews.text: I had my car towed to my mechanic shop in Sanford yesterday, their driver/tow personel was very nice and skilled in his job and me, no worries. Thank you. It was a great experience, awesome service.

reviews.author: Adrii Noel
reviews.text: I locked myself out of my car and Frank came to me. He came 45 minutes earlier than the ETA and was very friendly. Made conversation and made it seem like an easy fix. I’ve heard a lot about damage to the seals and even windows but did not have this experience with Frank. Definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Delorise Carter
reviews.text: Dalton Truck #6 was great with knowledge relating to my tow of my vehicle. Brownies has towed my family’s vehicles over the years and always exceeds expectations. Would always recommend.

reviews.author: Brittany Ford
reviews.text: Chase was awesome , professional and calm . He helped me and my family out when our car broke down . Even under pressure and the heat he still is able to do his job . Chase thank you so much for being a blessing to me and my family . We are grateful for you !

reviews.author: Desiree Rivera
reviews.text: An associate from this company, unlawfully took my car from my niece’s apartment complex. I stopped by for an hour and a half and within that time frame my car was towed. This was not the first time I had been over to visit my niece. On top of the fact that he had no merit in towing my car, he was rude, threatening, and disrespectful. He displayed no professionalism and he didn’t represent this towing company in a positive way. Unfortunately because of this man, my experience with this company gets a zero rating from me. :-(

reviews.author: Abel Lozano
reviews.text: I have Geico and these guys are fantastic when Geico makes the arrangements. Right now, I have a car to tow ten miles and even though I've been calling for the last three days, no one ever answers the phone. Guess it only counts when Geico is involved.

reviews.author: Jen Osborm
reviews.text: Horrible towing company. Terrible customer service, Jeff (not sure of position) is extremely rude. Even if you are in a pinch, I recommend you wait an extra few hours or minutes to get a reputable towing company. You were warned.

reviews.author: the_real_b_harv
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Levi and Anton were very helpful and took care of my vehicle, making sure no further damage was done to it during the process. These guy are awesome !

reviews.author: Ricardo Cabral
reviews.text: Our car broke down in Fayetteville and we had to be towed to Morrisville. From start to finish, everything was handled in a very professional manner. Brownie runs a tip top operation!

reviews.author: Joseph Rogers
reviews.text: Driver of tow truck number 14 aggressively approached me while I was picking up some dinner. I am a disabled navy veteran and can't walk long distance. The company needs to do a professional development on how to deal with the general public. I also suffer from PTSD and have a concealed carry license. Seeing his open carry could have resulted in an unfortunate situation. Lastly, why is he even here in Fayetteville NC trolling for business.STOP Harassing people, especially here off of south Reilly rd. Not the best place to be running up on a stranger at night. Ijs

reviews.author: LaShaun Jones
reviews.text: Gieco called this company for me & I'm not even sure if they showed up . My car was stuck in the mud in a ditch in my backyard. They told Geico my car was damaged & needed repairs. Obviously never even came to look at the car . I had to get another company to come & they took the car out with ease .

reviews.author: Brian Timothy Chambers
reviews.text: My car was stuck in the mud while leaving out of somebodies driveway, the guy came towed my car out but obviously he didn’t know what he was doing soon after he let my car down there was a strange Rattling sound which was obvious that my struts were damaged. I called this tow company and they try to blame the strut damage on being stuck in the mud. SAD PATHETIC AND UNPROFESSIONAL AND CLEARLY DOESNT KNOW WHAT THEY’RE DOING

reviews.author: Alycia Hurley
reviews.text: Initially called for a tow to the BMW dealership, but was unable to get into my vehicle(due to the battery was dead the key wouldn't work) so Anton-technician got into my car by popping the hood hatch & charged my battery a little, after he tried every door.He was so patient with my vehicle and the difficult way it was parked! Thank you Anton for being so helpful and saving me money!

reviews.author: Keri Spencer
reviews.text: I have had nothing but perfect service with them. Not only do they respond quickly they are ALWAYS professional and just awesome to deal with. I really appreciate how your service takes so much of the stress off of me. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Michael Rowser
reviews.text: Their service is great, but prices have tripled since I last employed their services. I received a quote for $300 compared to $95 paid for towing. I understand inflation, but to literally triple the price is insane.

reviews.author: Joyce Livingston
reviews.text: Excellent service. I was very lucky the gentleman arrived on time when he said he would. He said he would be there in 30 to 45 minutes and I believe he made it like 25 to 30 minutes. I would definitely use this service again but I hope I don't have to

reviews.author: maria davis
reviews.text: Dustin went above and beyond helping me. I've used Brownies a few times and I will always request them for my RSA. Thank you for your services and employees.

reviews.author: Haley Lockey
reviews.text: I had a really great experience with Brownie’s through Geico the last 2 days. They have great customer service and communicated with me every step of the way. I really appreciate all their help.

reviews.author: Road Side Assistance
reviews.text: If this is a local company they should use local dispatchers. The people who answer the phone are very poor at their job. You have to repeat everything 2-3 times and are put on hold for way to long to get a price which was $226 for a 3 mile tow

reviews.author: David Miles
reviews.text: Brownies is one of the oldest businesses in the area. They provide towing and recovery services to Cumberland and Hoke counties with a fleet of cable and rollback/flatbed wreckers. They provide road services for many organizations like USAA, ALLSTATE, etc. Also at the main office, they have and provide U-Haul vehicles and services.

reviews.author: Charles Shaw
reviews.text: Locked myself out of my truck in the cold weather on February 1. My roadside assistance sent brownies towing to assist me the driver Levi was great got me in my truck in no time. Thank you Levi Thank you Brownies towing

reviews.author: The McCains
reviews.text: Very Very Excellent Service ! I’m So Thankful For Anton One Of The Tow Drivers. He Came Out Twice To Help Us Due To The Fact Another Tow Company Never Came . I Will Definitely Recommend To Anyone That Ask About Towing . Thanks soooooo much !!!! Merry Christmas!

reviews.author: Christine Minor
reviews.text: Thank you Brownies!! Got me & my car from a bad area within 30 mins from calling!!! Thank you Phillip your a life & car saver!!! Couldn’t leave my challenger there.!!! Great job!!

reviews.author: Steve Pittman
reviews.text: Geico has sent Brownies to me twice & I have nothing but high praise for the professionalism, competence, & great attitude of my driver. Kudos.

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.text: I had to use this company recently for a row and the driver was very professional and Personable. I would highly recommend this company for your towing needs !

reviews.author: Timothy Gaylor
reviews.text: Great and local towing. Showed up on time. They do have the ability to tow cars and big trucks also..

reviews.author: Owner Jerrys auto
reviews.text: Owner Jerry's auto wayside rd over charge me for tow service charge me $350.oo for my truck witch was in front of my shop towed 100 yards driver very un professional would not even discuss the charge with me thanks

reviews.author: Max
reviews.text: out of 15 calls including 2 no shows with other companies these guys came in clutch, i’m very appreciative. quick and accurate service.

reviews.author: Lorena Andrade
reviews.text: Dustin on truck #3 came out promptly and properly got the car out and on the tow. Very professional thank you!!

reviews.author: James Wallace
reviews.text: Jim was just wonderful. He explained everything that he was going and had an up beat attitude. He is also very funny and lovable

reviews.author: syrita simmons
reviews.text: Like a special person I locked my keys the trunk and my latch does not work this guy did amazing job giving my keys ... Anton is vamazing

reviews.author: hakeem thompson
reviews.text: Aton had great customer service and helped a lot in the time of need in the late night. If I ever have another issue, I would ask for him personally.

reviews.author: Elijah Dumas
reviews.text: Instead of calling me to let me know they couldn't pick up my vehicle they just left it. They continued to tell me they couldn't pick up my vehicle because my yard is fenced in which is a lie.

reviews.author: Bernd Jeanes
reviews.text: Brownies came out due to locking myself out of my truck and had it done in no time! Very professional service

reviews.author: richard mcreynolds
reviews.text: Years ago i use there services. Very friendly driver and took care of my vehicle like it was brand new.

reviews.author: Jaime Stocking
reviews.text: The service man was very nice. He got to me in a very timely manner. He was very professional and efficient.

reviews.author: John Brunson
reviews.text: Thank you Anton, Truck #3, from Brownies Towing for your professional and friendly roadside emergency tire service.
